requirements.text: Define the package/seam/lane/promotion object family canonically.
Extend requested/effective runtime identity to include account and overseer role.
Choose one HITL model and one action family.
Separate plan structure from mutable runtime state.
Normalize recovery vocabulary across safe point, restore point, rollback, contamination, and retry.

decisions.text: Prioritize updates to Orchestrator_Page, Executor_Protocol, and Contracts_V0 as highest-impact docs under model pressure.
Treat Priority 1 cleanup docs as unable to safely coexist with the new model until reconciled.

data_shapes.text: Identity fields currently diverge between requested_persona/effective_persona and _id variants; account fallback fields are missing.
HITL payload shape is inconsistent between allowed_actions[] and allowed_action_ids[].
Graph/evidence schemas are node/tier-scoped and lack seam/package/lane/promotion/account lineage plus contamination/safe-point provenance.

routing_rules.text: Route blocked and major-decision attention through Dashboard -> Orchestrator -> chat-thread instead of thread-local flows.
Unify runtime action routing by retiring coexistence of cmd.graph.* recovery actions and canonical cmd.runtime.* actions.

verification_rules.text: GPT-5.3-Codex sweep findings identify impacted docs and contradictions requiring reconciliation.
Resolve scheduler truth conflicts across lexicographic, scored, and UI-derived recovery models before considering model convergence complete.

owner_consumer_obligations.text: Contracts and Orchestrator owners must reconcile canonical persona field naming before adding account identity.
SCM and integration owners must align tier/branch ownership with package-lane worktree pool ownership.

process_defects.text: Source Control ownership remains run/tier-based, preventing coherent Orchestrator and Source Control shared worktree model.
Fallback chunk-line settings disagree between sharding_config.json and auto_decisions.jsonl, indicating planning-state drift.
